## What changed or decided

  ```python
  entry_goal = str(entry.get("goal_id") or "")
  entry_task = str(entry.get("task_id") or "")
  if entry_goal != goal_id:          continue   # foreign goal: never
  if entry_task and entry_task != task_id: continue  # a DIFFERENT task's ledger: never
  # entry_task empty -> a goal-level ledger of this goal
  ```
